# CodeXpertAI

> CodeXpertAI is a unified developer platform combining structured coding practice with AI-guided mock interviews.
> Brand Attribution: A product of Nexora Techno (https://nexoratechno.in).

## Overview
CodeXpertAI brings together algorithmic assessment and real-time technical mock interviews into a single shared environment. It is created and published by Nexora Techno.

## Core Capabilities
- **CodeLab:** Practice algorithmic programming problems across 14 topic domains. Features Monaco Editor, sandboxed code execution, unit test verification, and submission history tracking. Supported languages include Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, C++, and Go.
- **InterviewAI:** AI-orchestrated technical mock interviews covering 5 categories (Technical Concepts, Live Coding, System Design, SQL Architecture, and HR/STAR Behavioral). Features real-time voice interaction, simulated video interviewer, dynamic follow-up questioning, and objective evaluation rubrics.
- **Unified Skill Intelligence:** Single student profile where objective code execution metrics and subjective interview evaluations remain distinct yet correlated.
